Thanks for contributing to difftastic! Please include all of the
following.

(1) A description of the change, and why it's worthwhile.

(2) Whether you used AI tools, and how. Write "none" if you didn't use
any. Using AI tools is fine, but difftastic requires that you disclose
it: see
[AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Wilfred/difftastic/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md).

(3) Confirmation that you've read all the code you're proposing, and
can discuss any part of it.
